rationale: Price is sitting at 88.5% of today's range after a 10.5% gap-up on strong earnings, but the last five 1-minute candles show a clear deceleration and mild drift lower (from ~87.98 down to ~87.78), with the 9-EMA at $87.95 now acting as resistance above current price. Momentum is fading near the day's high with 84 minutes left, making a long entry risky of a mean-reversion pullback, while shorting into a strong fundamental catalyst with elevated relative volume (5.54x) and a broad market up 1.74% carries equal risk. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear enough to warrant sitting out this cycle.
